owner_changes.query: We need type-ahead place suggestions that we can bias to a search area and filter by place type. Which of Google Places Autocomplete (New), Ola Places Autocomplete, and Mapbox Search Box document those capabilities?
Which Directions APIs can return a driving route that avoids ferries, and how can we tell whether that capability is documented?
If we self-host OSRM on OpenStreetMap data for routing, what licensing obligations do we have?
Which Directions APIs can return a multi-stop driving route with separate distances and travel times for every leg, while visiting the stops in the order we supply?
Our drivers prefer Tamil. Can the directions API return turn-by-turn instructions in Tamil?
Google Maps Platform quote: 3,000 matrix requests per month in India, each a 20×20 matrix, on a brand-new GCP project.
Can we store Mapbox reverse-geocoding results in our own database for later reuse, and does the public Nominatim policy allow us to resell those geocoding results?
Which reverse geocoders document a way to look up many coordinates in a single batch request?

method: Deterministic routing replay; fresh handoff classifications preserved because the policy does not enter that path.
